title: Subregular affine cells and the level $-1$ vertex algebra of type $D$
summary: We prove the simple-object prediction of Shan--Yan--Zhao and a basis-preserving dual-cell realization for the distinguished vacuum block of the simple affine vertex algebras $L_{-1}(D_\ell)$, $\ell\ge5$. The block has exactly $\ell+1$ simple objects, indexed by the subregular affine left cell containing $s_0$. The proof combines a primitive-ideal inclusion, an independent exhaustion argument, and a finite-length step.
